subject: Runway orchestration: GPU pool handshake & MAP for Eagle Health evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@eaglehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@eaglehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sketch of evaluation scope + timing question

Priyom —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We want to move from proof-of-concept to a short pilot to validate latency/cost and safety controls. Two quick asks as we build the MAP:

1) What lead time should we expect if we reserve a private Dedicated GPU pool (on our VPC) vs. reserved hosted capacity? Our procurement needs a calendar to sign off.
2) For sizing, we think an initial eval with 12k daily tokens across two inference classes — can you propose a minimal GPU footprint for a 4-week evaluation?

Also, we need a simple mutual action plan doc to share with procurement. Can you sketch milestones and acceptance criteria so we can align internal stakeholders?

Thanks — Jordan
VP, AI Product
Eagle Health

(Phone: 415-555-0132)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@eaglehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sketch of evaluation scope + timing question

Jordan — thanks, great next step. I put together a concise MAP and a proposed runway orchestration for the 4-week evaluation (attached: MAP_v1_EagleHealth.xlsx). High-level answers up front:

- Lead times: Hosted reserved capacity (hosted API with reserved throughput) can be provisioned within 3–5 business days for the eval lane. Private Dedicated (VPC-based private pools) typically requires 8–12 weeks from signed SOW due to networking, KMS integration, and acceptance windows.

- Minimal footprint (4-week eval, 12k daily tokens split across two classes): recommend staged approach —
  * Stage A (dev & smoke): 2 x A100 equivalent for warmup, 24/7 for 3 days
  * Stage B (evaluation): 4 x A100 equivalent steady for the 4-week window (peak concurrency ~6), with auto-burst to 8 for 30-min windows
  * Expected cost profile/throughput numbers are in the attached CSV (proposed-sku.csv).

Attached MAP includes: milestones, owner for each task, gating criteria (latency P95 < 350ms, inference accuracy delta < 2% vs baseline), SOC2 evidence checklist, and rollback policy.

Next steps I propose:
1) We share the MAP with procurement and your security lead (Alyssa) this week.
2) Sign a short SOW for a hosted reserved eval to start within 72 hours while we parallelize Private onboarding if you want the Dedicated lane.
3) Internal call to agree on acceptance tests (I'll loop Ben for performance tuning).

If that sounds good I'll send an uplifted timeline with dates and owners.

— Priyom
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: MAP_v1_EagleHealth.xlsx (xlsx), proposed-sku.csv (csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: prep for Eagle Health MAP alignment

Folks — quick internal note before we send the finalized MAP to Jordan/Alyssa:

- Network/Dedicated notes: if they want Private, infra will require a VPC peering/VPN and KMS test vector. Realistically factor 10 business days for networking sign-off once we have IP ranges and KMS endpoints. That sits inside the 8–12 week total.
- Acceptance: add a perf smoke step after we replicate their token-distribution (we should capture a 48-hour synthetic run to validate KV caching behavior).
- Capacity: recommend adding a 10% buffer to the A100-equivalent counts to cover bursty med-traffic days.

I'll prepare a short checklist for the onboarding runbook and a staging acceptance script (shell + perf harness). Priyom — want me to drop the script in the Drive link you referenced?

— Ben
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@eaglehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@eaglehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway orchestration: GPU pool handshake & MAP for Eagle Health evaluation

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifying points from security/procurement: 

- Private timeline: 8–12 weeks is acceptable but procurement will want milestone-based payment terms and a staged deliverable list. Can you add explicit acceptance gates with sign-off owners and deliverables by week?
- SOC2: please attach a short evidence pack (we don't need the full report) — a SOC2_summary.pdf that lists relevant controls and where logs/retention live.
- Eval footprint: Jordan and I are comfortable starting hosted reserved capacity to accelerate. We need the SOW and price estimate (hosted reserved for 4 weeks) to route to finance.

Can you produce an updated MAP with week-by-week milestones, owners, and a one-page pricing appendix? If possible, we prefer a go/no-go checkpoint at the end of week 1 based on P95 latency and error-rate thresholds.

Thanks, Alyssa
Sr. Director, Security & Risk
Eagle Health

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@eaglehealth.com>, Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@eaglehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 20:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway orchestration: GPU pool handshake & MAP for Eagle Health evaluation

Jordan / Alyssa — attached an updated MAP with a week-by-week runway and explicit acceptance sign-offs (MAP_v1_EagleHealth.xlsx updated). I also attached a short SOC2 summary for the controls we exercise (SOC2_summary.pdf) and a one-page pricing appendix in the Drive link. Highlights below: 

Week 0 (contracting, SOW sign): finance countersigned SOW + PO received; owner: Jordan (Eagle), Priyom (Redwood).
Week 1 (hosted reserved spin + smoke): provision hosted reserved lane, run 48h synthetic; acceptance owner: Alyssa (security) + Ben (Redwood). Go/no-go decision at EOD week 1 (criteria: P95 < 350ms, error < 0.5%).
Week 2 (evaluation ramp): full traffic shape applied, live QA tests, telemetry review; owner: Jordan + Ben.
Week 3 (stability & tuning): KV cache tuning and quantization trial for cost savings; owner: Ben.
Week 4 (handover): acceptance sign-off and handoff to Eagle production plan OR continue Private onboarding; owner: Jordan + Priyom.

Private onboarding path (parallel): kickoff networking and KMS integration upon SOW sign; expected completion 8–12 weeks with intermediate checkpoints at weeks 3, 6, 9. Milestone-based billing proposed (submit schedule in Drive).

Action items (owners, due dates):
- Priyom: deliver SOW + pricing appendix (today EOD) — DONE (Drive link)
- Ben: upload staging perf script and acceptance harness (Mon 20 Jul)
- Jordan/Alyssa: confirm PO path and internal approvers (Mon 20 Jul)

Attachments: MAP_v1_EagleHealth.xlsx (updated), SOC2_summary.pdf, proposed-sku.csv

I'll follow up with a short calendar invite for the week-0 contracting sync. If you want us to start hosted reserved immediately, say the word and we'll schedule provisioning within 72 hours.

— Priyom
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: MAP_v1_EagleHealth.xlsx (xlsx), SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf), proposed-sku.csv (csv)
